unsupported.fact: EN->>EN: a typed parameter or self seeds Param / EN->>EN: a let binding seeds Bound / opt a pattern binding ... (drawn in that order)
unsupported.why: The original gives Param, Bound and Destructured as three parallel entries from [*]; it claims no order between parameter seeding, let handling and pattern handling, nor that pattern handling follows the let outcome.

changed.fact: EN->>EN: a typed parameter or self seeds Param, then EN->>EN: a let binding seeds Bound (both unconditional)
changed.original: [*] --> Param: typed parameter or self; [*] --> Bound: let binding
changed.why: Alternative entry points for a name are drawn as two unconditional steps that both happen; the let-binding path (and its alt) is shown as always taken.

changed.original: Typed --> Restored; Computed --> Restored; Derived --> Restored
changed.why: Exclusive per-binding states (Typed vs Computed vs Derived) are drawn as three sequential messages that all occur, so mutually exclusive outcomes appear to happen together.
